A couple of technical nuggets so everyone is aligned:

- Raw ownership: Redwood will provide raw MP4s pulled from the encoder. We can deliver a single-master file and separate clip files upon request. The sponsor clip release should designate whether we are delivering masters or only edited clips.
- Watermarking: default is Redwood lower-third watermark on the full recording. For sponsor clips we can produce versions without the Redwood watermark, but that requires an explicit clause in the release (we should enumerate brand attribution requirements).
- Breakout recording: Zoom only records the main session by default; if the sponsor wants the breakout recorded separately (i.e., separate MP4 of the breakout room), we need to enable per-breakout recording and verify storage. That will increase file size and S3 egress.

I'm attaching short-clip-specs.md with our recommended deliverables and formats. Laura — can you check the release draft and add the clause about watermark removal + distribution rights?
